outputs.prompt:

SIX complete articulated figures in 3 columns x 2 rows, clear generous gutters and margins around every weapon and foot. Same three-quarter camera facing screen RIGHT, identical body and equipment scale throughout. Genuine transparent background, no drawn checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no ground shadows, no scenery. No new equipment or added limbs. Preserve original paint style and identity.
Inputs1-4 are leg-pose diagrams ONLY in sequential order; input5 is exact painted identity/costume reference. First four cells follow diagrams1,2,3,4 respectively, keeping same three-quarter right-facing torso and head, stocky humanoid proportions. BLUE diagram leg means anatomical RIGHT foreground leg; ORANGE means anatomical LEFT background leg, but render both in the original gold/black armor, no blue/orange guide paint. First contact: near RIGHT leg forward, far LEFT behind. Passing: near RIGHT supports and far LEFT knee/boot raised. Opposite contact: far LEFT forward, near RIGHT behind. Opposite passing: far LEFT supports, near RIGHT knee/boot raised. Preserve visible knee ownership and exactly one knee per leg, no duplicated plates. Identity: Gaugeplate Bailiff, squat brass/black armor, brass respirator beard mask with BLUE goggles, blue scarf, blue/ivory tabard, backpack boiler and pipes. RIGHT hand viewer-left carries fixed-size square gauge hammer near shoulder; LEFT arm viewer-right carries fixed-size round gauge shield before ribs. Do not swap hands or turn torso around. Keep hammer/shield restrained and consistent during gait. Quiet vents, no steam, keep pipe hardware. Fifth cell (bottom-middle): strong defensive brace, shield raised before chest/face with goggles partly visible, hammer low at right side, both boots planted. Sixth (bottom-right): follow-through brace with knees slightly compressed and same shield position, hammer still in right hand. Do not generate a fifth walking phase or new weapon. No diagrams or captions in output.
